versions.changelog: Read-only audit: every write removed (no daily-memory append, no mkdir), no environment-controlled workspace or projects paths, project slugs validated, git status run with core.fsmonitor and core.hooksPath pinned off, stale-hours input validated.
Security-first refresh: no builder execution or hook sourcing, explicit-only trigger, status computed before the memory write, CLOSEOUT_PROJECTS check implemented, MIT license, portable stat.
Initial release — structured end-of-session hygiene for OpenClaw workspaces
